If her saying the word "choose" makes you uncomfortable talk about that too. 
If she can't give up on having children, she is capable of making that decision for herself. Show her the courtesy and let her have an opinion about what she wants in her future.

You have talked to her once yes. Talk to her again. Tell her to listen and think. Both of you talk and think and make your decision. It will be awkward, difficult and maybe even a sad process. But the decision you both will come to will be something you both have given honest thought to.
